annotations.title: Tubal or vasectomy reversal vs IVF: posted prices

description: What US practices post on their own websites for a tubal ligation reversal or a vasectomy reversal (and, for vasectomy, a surgical sperm retrieval), each quoted with its page, beside one IVF cycle's cited cost, with what ASRM (tubal) or the AUA/ASRM guideline (vasectomy) says decides between reversal and IVF.
